title: Aug 29 Results: Thirteen Wins Never Gets Old
summary: Aug 29 delivers 13-4 performance with 76.5% accuracy across Saturday's slate

content.value:
## Another Saturday in the Books

You know, I've been doing this long enough to recognize when the model's really dialed in. Thirteen wins out of seventeen picks? That's the kind of day that reminds you why we trust the numbers. Sure, we had a couple misses—the Dodgers stumbling in Detroit and that second Giants-Diamondbacks game going sideways—but a 76.5% hit rate on a busy Saturday slate? I'll take that every time.

## The Big Picture

What stood out today wasn't just the win total—it was how our highest-confidence picks performed. When we liked the Blue Jays at 63% against Seattle, they delivered. The Diamondbacks at 62% in that first game? Money. Even the coin-flip calls like the Cardinals at 50% and Nationals at 50% broke our way more often than not.

content.title: Today's Prediction Results by Confidence Level

content.value:
## Where We Missed

Let's talk about those four losses, because that's where we learn. The Dodgers as 61% favorites in Detroit? Sometimes a hot Tigers lineup catches lightning in a bottle. That second Diamondbacks-Giants game at 51%? That's essentially a toss-up disguised as a slight lean. And the Cardinals at 50%? That's baseball—even splits don't always split evenly.

The key here is we didn't miss on any of our highest-confidence plays above 63%. That's disciplined modeling right there.

## The White Sox Surprise

Here's something I didn't expect to write today: the White Sox went 2-for-2 in our picks. They took the first game of that Yankees doubleheader at 55%, then we correctly pivoted to the Yankees in game two. That's the beauty of treating each game independently—rosters change, bullpens get taxed, and the model adjusts.

content.sub: Our highest confidence pick delivered as Toronto's bats came alive

## No Games Tomorrow

Here's the thing about the baseball calendar—sometimes you get a Saturday with ten games on the slate, and sometimes you get a Sunday with absolutely nothing. No games scheduled for August 30th means we take a breath, review what worked today, and get ready for Monday's action.

I've been around long enough to appreciate these quiet moments. They don't happen often during the summer stretch, so when they do, you use them to sharpen the pencil and prepare for what's coming.

## Final Thoughts

A 13-4 day doesn't happen by accident. It happens when the model identifies true edges, when the data tells a clear story, and when we trust the process even on those 50-51% picks that could go either way. 

We'll be back when the games resume. Until then, enjoy this 76.5% winner of a Saturday.

— Max
